verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents stakeholder access in its centralized platform, a setting for shareholder equity value visibility, and permission controls. Together these imply stakeholders can see their own holdings. A 'Create and Share Messages' feature and a built-in data room suggest a channel for pushing updates. However, most of this evidence is support-article titles or marketing lines rather than a described investor portal with structured update workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an investor-facing portal showing each investor's holdings, detail on structured investor updates (format, cadence, recipients), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the investor experience.
